{{Quote|Captain Averen of Monarch has sent a truce-byte out to everyone.|Sirlul to Admiral Ackbar|<ref name="WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>}}
A '''Truce-byte''' was usually sent as proof of an unconditional surrender.<ref name="WG" />

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], during the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Liberation of Coruscant]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] announced their surrender to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] when [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Averen]] sent out a truce-byte.<ref name="WG" />
